chunks: He knows whatever goes into the earth and whatsoever issues from it, whatsoever comes down from the sky, and whatsoever goes up to it. He is all-merciful, all-forgiving.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Allah's knowledge of natural elements and His attributes of mercy?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Allah's absolute dominion over the vertical axis of creation, from the subterranean depths to the celestial realms, illustrating His intimate awareness of all transitions. The juxtaposition of His all-encompassing knowledge with the attributes of Mercy and Forgiveness serves as a theological anchor, reminding believers that divine oversight is not merely observational but inherently benevolent, a concept often linked to the Imam's role as the conduit of this divine grace.
